title: Russian attacks kill three and cut power to freezing Ukrainian regions
summary: Four-year-old child among those killed in drone and missile assault targeting energy infrastructure amid cold snap A massive Russian drone and missile attack on Ukraine has killed three people and cut power to several Ukrainian regions two days before Christmas and as the country enters a cold snap. Russia sent more than 650 drones and more than 30 missiles into Ukraine in the attack, which began overnight and continued into Tuesday morning, local officials said. At least three people were killed, including a four-year-old child. Continue reading...
